acceptance: The cause is reproduced and identified; whether it predates or follows PR #4228 (CLI and MCP parity) is stated.
MCP SF1 DuckDB TPC-H completes like the CLI, verified with a real stdio client under make heavy-run.
Any run that ends without a result returns an MCP error (is_error true) with the cause; a test covers it.
context: Found while measuring MCP run times for PR #4230 on 2026-11-14. Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight); never edit the primary clone. Related items share one feature branch and PR where their files overlap. No live-cloud runs and no credentials in Git or logs; heavy work only through lock-taking entry points or make heavy-run after make heavy-status. Follow the comment policy and add a changelog.d fragment for user-facing changes. Re-verify every cited file and line before acting; they are hints. Stop and report rather than widen scope.
description:
Problem: through a real MCP stdio client, run_benchmark for DuckDB TPC-H SF1 returned status 'incomplete', no result file and is_error false in three runs (also with a fresh HOME). The server log shows row_count_validation.actual (56) must match rows_returned (0), then QueryExecutionContractError. The same request through the CLI completes. Two defects: the run fails, and the failure is not reported as an error, so an agent may treat it as success.

Possibly related: stale-shared-output-dir-tpch-q18-mismatch-20261114 saw TPC-H SF1 Q18 return 56 rows against 57 expected when reusing data from the shared output directory.
